description.text: One of the two fifth expansions of the Sun & Moon series, released together with Ultra Moon on 8 December 2017. Dusk Mane Necrozma made its card debut as a Pokémon-GX, and the two packs brought many Pokémon and Trainers of the Sinnoh region: Ultra Sun holds Turtwig and Chimchar, Leafeon-GX and Dialga-GX, whose attack was the first to give its player an extra turn. The packs also introduced Prism Star cards, a new rarity: a deck may hold only one card of each Prism Star name, and they go to the Lost Zone instead of the discard pile. Ultra Sun's are Solgaleo, Darkrai and Cyrus. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 66, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX and Supporters, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Peeking Red Card, Missing Clover and Unit Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Ultra Prism in February 2018.
